satisfaction_statement.question: Which ONE of the following statements BEST describes the way you feel about the action taken by the R.J. Reynolds Consumer Relations Department to respond to your request for assistance?
options: I was NOT completely satisfied but the action taken was acceptable.
I was NOT completely satisfied but some action was taken.
I was NOT AT ALL satisfied with the action taken.
I was NOT AT ALL satisfied; no action was taken.

purchase_intention.question: Based on how well you were treated by our representative, will you continue to purchase the brand of cigarettes you contacted us about?

recommendation.question: Would you recommend this brand of cigarettes to an adult smoker (21 years of age or older)?

survey.additional_comments:
Would like to go back to the old way of at least 2 face options per household & a catalog with quality goods such as Ball jars, Mason jars, wood radios - solid walnut jewelry boxes - binoculars & etc., such as "Nerf" & "Ferro". I now have over 100 seals & smoke at least 2 cigs daily. At this rate at 70 "I" won't live long enough to use them up.

Thank you
Jack R. Butts
